title: Stochastic Barrier Certificates in the Presence of Dynamic Obstacles
summary: In this work, we focus on safety verification of stochastic systems in dynamic environments. We introduce both time-invariant and time-varying barrier certificates for discrete-time, continuous-space systems subject to uncertainty, which provide certified lower bounds on the probability of remaining within a safe set over a finite horizon. These certificates explicitly account for time-varying unsafe regions induced by obstacle dynamics.
